statement: Two separately neutral groups of the preceding kind can be chosen so that their combined amplitude in (5.2) is nonzero. The formula then has a relative power error, including when the two α-points have opposite colors and least separation r ≥ n1−ξ, for a sufficiently small fixed ξ > 0. Place the first core at the origin, the second at odd axial separation r ≍ n1−ξ, and all compen- sators at distinct positions nzj + O(1), with fixed nonzero axial zj. Write B∗ = P j remote β(tj). There is a constant M∗ ̸= 0, depending only on those charges, their macroscopic positions, and the fixed microscopic conventions, such that Cr(n) = M∗nB∗−x r2Aα2 (1 + O(n−c )) = M∗nB∗ r−2x1 (r/n)x (1 + O(n−c )), x1 = −β(α). (5.8) The same conclusion is uniform for n1−ξ ≤ r ≤ n1−ξ′ , with fixed 0 < ξ′ ≤ ξ, after decreasing c. For r = an with fixed small a > 0, the full Coulomb product applies; its remaining geometric factor tends to M∗ as a ↓ 0 and stays bounded above and away from zero.
